newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Cadbury Schweppes opens Russia sweets plant.
newsitem.headline: Cadbury Schweppes opens Russia sweets plant.

text.p: Britain's Cadbury's, the confectionary arm of Cadbury Schweppes Plc opened a chocolate plant in Russia's Novgorod region on Tuesday, Interfax news agency quoted a top company official as saying.

The company invested $120 million in the greenfield project, Cadbury's largest outside Britain, to produce about 45,000 tonnes of chocolate bars. The official said Russia was the third largest European market for Cadbury.
Mars of the U.S. has built a factory in the Moscow region, while Switzerland's Nestle has re-equipped an existing plant in the Samara region.
